description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.


About the role

We are looking for a manufacturing systems engineer to own the production process and make it ready for a significant scaleup. You will work closely with our engineering and production team in Zürich to make our production more reliable and scalable.


This role is very hands-on and you will spend a lot of your time on the shop floor solving issues and improving production hand in hand with assembly technicians. You will be building out a world class production system to support a rapidly growing supply base.   


What you will do

  • Own how our product is built from start to finish

  • Create and maintain production process documentation, both for internal and external manufacturing

  • Improve workstation layout, flow design and tooling from incoming goods to product shipping

  • Support make vs buy decisions and supplier selection

  • Support new product introduction from development to production

  • Close DFM feedback loop to improve manufacturability


    • What we're looking for

  • A university degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics Engineering or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years experience in manufacturing / process engineering in mid volume manufacturing

  • Taken a product from prototype to repeatable series production before

  • CAD knowledge for designing fixtures and reviewing designs

  • Solid understanding of mechanical and electrical systems

  • Good command of English, both written and spoken

  • Willing to travel ~20% internationally to support external manufacturing


    • Beneficial experience

  • ERP / MRP Systems

  • BOM management

  • GD&T

  • Python for test automation and production tooling

  • Agentic tools for writing code and automating workflows

  • Off-highway, agricultural, mining or other harsh-environment equipment 

    • This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.

    Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
description:
Functie  Reliability engineer

 

Beschrijving functie

 

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

 

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 



Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

 

  • Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

  • Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

  • Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

  • Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.

  • Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout



    • Taken

    1. Trouble shooting

      1. Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen

      2. Daily problem solving

    2. Continue verbeteren

      1. Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten

      2. Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid

      3. Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten

    3. Change Management

      1. Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) 

      2. Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines

      3. Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten 

    4. Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid

      1. Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark

      2. Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.

    5. Investeringsprojecten

      1. Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.

      2. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.

      3. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.

    6. Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen

      1. Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten

      2. Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen  en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

    7. Beheren van de Standard Operating Procedures voor de installaties (SOP)

      1. Schrijven van nieuwe SOP’s, inclusief autonoom onderhoud

      2. Herzien van SOP’s als gevolg van proces verbeteringen en aanpassingen

    8. Bewaken standaarden voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

      1. Uitvoeren van risico assessments

      2. Borgen dat processen voldoen aan veiligheids standaarden en kwaliteits standaarden.

      3. Uitvoeren van optimalisatie testen.

      4. Ontwikkelen van best practice  die de productkwaliteit borgen

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services.

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites.

As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.

title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
description:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

title: Defense Success Manager, France
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout.


What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

  • Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience owning outcomes for enterprise or institutional customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

  • Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

  • Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security stakeholders, while translating technical trade-offs into clear implications for mission owners and executives. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

  • Comfort operating under security, compliance and confidentiality constraints, including restricted or classified environments and strict information-handling rules.

  • Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion

  • Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics with imperfect data, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.


Nice to have

  • Experience serving defense, public sector or critical infrastructure customers, including sovereign or classified programs.

  • Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

  • Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

  • Familiarity with public procurement, framework agreements and multi-year option structures.

Security & Compliance criteria

  • Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

  • Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance (e.g. no criminal record, fulfillment of national service obligations).

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer

Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

  • Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

  • Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

  • Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

  • Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

  • The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.

We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.

We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.

  • Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.

  • Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.

  • Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

  • We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with.

  • Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

  • Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  1. Send your CV.

  2. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

title: Founding Optimization Engineer
description:
Founding Optimization Engineer

Build the algorithmic core of planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape the optimization architecture on a greenfield: custom algorithms, heuristics, OR and simulation, fast C++ with Python on top. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The algorithmic core: Design how planqor.ai represents, propagates and optimizes schedules, resources and constraints, and how it repairs them when disruptions hit.

  • Performance: Make it fast. Profile and optimize the C++ core and expose it cleanly.

  • Evidence: Build the benchmarks, instances and experiments that show what actually works and where it fails.

  • The path to production: Work with our systems engineer to turn algorithms into decisions planners trust.

  • The team: Grow into leading optimization at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our goal is not to build the most impressive optimization algorithm on paper. It is to build decision systems that remain useful when the real world changes. A strong solution that can be updated, repaired and explained quickly beats closing the last optimality gap on a static model.

So we are neither a solver wrapper nor a research lab. We use whatever works (MIP, CP, heuristics, local search, simulation, learning or something purpose-built) and let the evidence decide.

Generative AI makes this loop dramatically faster. We use it to implement ideas, explore alternatives and evolve algorithms against our benchmarks. But speed only counts if the methodology holds: representative data, adversarial tests, meaningful metrics, rigorous validation.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong modern C++ and performance engineering. You are comfortable building performance-critical algorithms, profiling them, choosing appropriate data structures, and reasoning about runtime, memory, and scalability.

  • Real experience solving optimization problems. This may come from Operations Research, combinatorial optimization, scheduling, MIP/CP, heuristics, local search, simulation, optimization under uncertainty, or related fields. You do not need to be an expert in all of them. Big plus for Sequential Decision Analytics.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual models and algorithms: how state is represented, how changes propagate, how components interact, and how the complete decision system behaves under real-world disruptions.

  • Python for experimentation and data analysis. You can build benchmark pipelines, analyze data, visualize results, and quickly investigate why an approach succeeds or fails.

  • Empirical engineering judgment. You design experiments, challenge assumptions, measure performance, and abandon approaches when the evidence says they are wrong.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

What you'll get

  • Ownership: shape the optimization architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the optimization team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

  • We equip you with the hardware, compute and tools you work best with.

  • Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

  • Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  1. Send your CV.

  2. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

More at home in backend and product? Check out our Founding Full-Stack Engineer role.

Dabei stellst du sicher, dass alle benötigten Informationen vorliegen und die richtigen Ansprechpartner:innen eingebunden sind.

Warum wir?

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben.

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung.

title: Lead Performance Marketing & User Acquisition
description:
We are Whow Games – and YOU could be part of it!

At WHOW Games, we develop, publish and market social casino games for web and mobile that are played by millions of people. We’re an international team of more than 50 people, and our Marketing team works closely with Product, CRM and Business Intelligence.

As Lead Performance Marketing & User Acquisition, you’ll lead and develop our Performance Marketing team. You’ll set a clear direction, agree on goals together and give people the support and autonomy to take ownership and grow. You’ll lead by example when it’s time to test a new idea, make a difficult call or learn from a setback. You’ll also own our UA strategy and budget across web and mobile, working with your team to grow our core markets profitably and identify which new markets are worth entering.

Tasks

  • Lead and develop the team. Set clear goals, delegate responsibility and give regular feedback. Get to know each team member’s strengths, support their development and coach them to make decisions independently.

  • Give the team direction and keep people motivated. Help team members see how their work contributes to the business and recognise their progress. When priorities shift or campaigns underperform, clarify what matters most, remove obstacles and agree on next steps together.

  • Own UA strategy and budget. Set acquisition goals for web and mobile and allocate spend across platforms, channels and markets based on cohort ROAS, payback and lifetime value (LTV). Stay hands-on with key campaigns and experiments.

  • Grow core markets and test new countries. Work with your team to reach new audiences and find promising channels. Define success criteria for new markets, lead the tests and recommend where further investment makes sense.

  • Manage channels and partners. Own the mix across Google, Meta, Apple Search Ads, ad networks, programmatic, TikTok and affiliates. Negotiate directly with agencies and partners and decide which work your team handles in-house.

  • Improve testing and measurement. Prioritise experiments for ad creatives, app store listings and landing pages with Design and Content. Work with BI and technical teams to improve tracking, attribution and reporting so that results inform campaign and budget decisions.

  • Represent the team across the business. Align acquisition goals with Product, CRM and BI so we bring in more players who stay active over time. Present your team’s results to management and explain where you recommend increasing, reducing or reallocating spend.

Requirements

  • At least eight years of experience in performance marketing or user acquisition, with a substantial part of that time in gaming or a similarly data-driven B2C environment.

  • Experience leading a marketing, growth or UA team. You can share concrete examples of how you’ve set goals, delegated responsibility and helped people develop. You give clear feedback and know how to keep a team motivated through uncertainty.

  • A proven track record of scaling acquisition budgets profitably. You can explain the decisions you made and use concrete numbers to show how cohort ROAS, payback or LTV changed as spend increased.

  • Hands-on experience with web and app campaigns across Google and Meta, plus experience with Apple Search Ads or ad networks such as AppLovin, Unity or Moloco.

  • Practical experience with a mobile measurement partner such as AppsFlyer or Adjust, GA4 and server-side tracking. You understand how GDPR, consent, ATT and SKAdNetwork affect measurement.

  • The ability to make decisions with incomplete data, set clear priorities and explain your reasoning to your team and to management.

  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in your day-to-day work, for example to develop creative variants, analyse results or streamline reporting.

  • Fluent English and very good German.

Nice to have

  • Social casino experience and familiarity with relevant advertising and app store policies.

  • Previous experience leading or developing a performance marketing, growth or user acquisition team is a plus.

  • Experience entering new markets and scaling user acquisition after launch.

  • Experience building or developing a UA team.

  • An established network of gaming agencies, ad networks or other partners.

  • Experience working with creators or streamers on Twitch or YouTube.

  • Additional languages.

Benefits

  • A professional and experienced team with many years of expertise in the gaming industry

  • A dynamic working environment with flat hierarchies, fast decision-making processes, and plenty of room for your own ideas

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely, with two days per week in the office expected

  • Regular company events

  • Free fruit and drinks as well as meal subsidies

  • A subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • The option to join Wellpass

Sounds like you? Then send us your CV and a few lines about the growth project you are most proud of. Numbers welcome.

title: Senior Platform & Security Engineer – Cloud, DevSecOps & AI Agents
description:
🏢 About 21bitcoin

We are 21bitcoin. We believe in a future where Bitcoin is a natural part of everyone's life – simple, secure, and easy to understand.

We're looking for people who want to help build a real mission – not just do a job. With us, you'll take on responsibility early, work with a highly motivated international team and actively shape the future of money.

👋 The role

As a Senior Platform & Security Engineer, you are the hands-on solution architect for our cloud platform, our security, and our AI agent infrastructure. You work within the Platform & Security team and support the Backend team in our AWS environment.

The role combines DevOps, Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, and Security Engineering. You design solutions, build them yourself, and run them in production. You also bring practical AI experience and help us build and operate AI agents in a regulated environment. Moreover, you provide guidance to engineers on other teams when it comes to infrastructure and security.

Tasks

🚀 Your mission

You build the foundation our product and our engineers rely on every day. This is what you own, and what good looks like:

  • A platform teams can rely on: You architect and run our AWS infrastructure as code, with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows that let teams ship faster and with greater confidence.

  • Security by default: You secure our AWS environment across all accounts and build security checks into our pipelines, so engineers ship securely without manual gatekeeping. Findings are fixed on time.

  • Detection and response that works: You build monitoring and alerting where every alert is worth acting on, and you lead security incident response from investigation to post-mortem.

  • AI agents in production: We are moving to agentic coding, and you build the infrastructure for it, for example dedicated, secure environments in which agents can act. You also design, deploy, and operate AI agents that take over repetitive platform and security work in a controlled, auditable way.

  • Architecture and guidance: You turn product and engineering requirements into clear designs and guide other teams through implementation.

🌱 Your first months

Your impact starts on day one. You dive straight into our AWS platform and ship your first changes to production within weeks, not months. From there, core parts of our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security, and AI agents become yours: you set the direction, make the calls, and watch your work run in production. You do none of this alone: together with the team, you drive the work that makes our platform and IT secure and puts AI agents into production. You challenge each other's ideas, share what you learn, and get further together than any of you would alone. We are looking for self-driven engineers who would rather shape a platform than work through a task list. If that is you, you will find the room, the trust, and the responsibility to do it here.

Requirements

🛠️ Your toolbox

These are examples of the technologies we work with, not a complete list.

  • Cloud & infrastructure: AWS in a multi-account setup, with serverless and container workloads and networking (VPC, AWS Network Firewall)

  • Infrastructure as Code: for example CDK, OpenTofu, and Terraform, run on a platform such as env0, Scalr, or Terraform Cloud

  • CI/CD & containers: for example GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or CircleCI, with GitOps and Docker

  • Observability & incident management: monitoring, alerting, and on-call, for example with Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic, and PagerDuty, Rootly, or incident.io

  • Security: code and pipeline scanning with tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or Aikido (SAST, DAST, dependency, container and secrets scanning, IaC security), plus AWS security services such as Amazon Inspector and AWS Security Hub

  • Identity & access: central identity management and zero-trust network access

  • AI & agents: agent platforms such as Amazon Bedrock (AgentCore) or the Claude platform

  • Languages: Python, Node.js (TypeScript), Terraform

⭐ What you bring

We are looking for a high performer with an engineering mindset. You think in systems, automate what repeats, and build for where our platform needs to be next year, not only for today's ticket.

  • Senior and hands-on: 5+ years in software engineering and DevOps, Platform, DevSecOps, or Security Engineering. You have designed cloud, platform, and security solutions end to end and can explain the trade-offs.

  • You code (must-have): Python, Node.js, and Terraform, at a level where you direct agentic coding tools, review their output critically, and own the result.

  • AWS in depth: Multi-account setups with AWS Organizations and Control Tower, containers and serverless, VPC security design, AWS Network Firewall, AWS Security Hub, and Amazon Inspector, all managed as code with tools such as CDK, OpenTofu, or Terraform.

  • Security in the pipeline and in production: You have built CI/CD pipelines with integrated security scanning (tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or Aikido), operated security controls with logging, monitoring, and alerting, and handled security incidents end to end. You are comfortable being on call.

  • AI in practice: You have applied AI in engineering work and know how to run it responsibly in production. Ideally, you have already built on agent platforms and frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock (AgentCore) or the Claude platform.

  • Ownership and teamwork: You take responsibility for outcomes, explain technical topics clearly to any audience, and treat security as a partnership with engineering, not a gate.

A plus: workflow orchestration with Temporal, Restate, or Inngest, and production experience with a Terraform platform such as env0, Scalr, or Terraform Cloud, as well as GitLab and JumpCloud.

Benefits

💡 Why join 21bitcoin

  • Hybrid work: Work flexibly and meet the team in person at our hubs in Vienna, Salzburg, or Munich a few times per month.

  • Top tech stack: Work with a modern, cloud-native stack across AWS, Infrastructure as Code, observability, security tooling, and AI agents.

  • Learn and improve: Grow across platform, security, architecture, and AI, with real problems to solve and room to develop your skills.

  • Impact across the stack: Your work shapes the platform, the security posture, and the systems that power the product.

  • Ownership and responsibility: Take full ownership of critical systems in a fast-paced, regulated environment.

  • Collaborative team: Join a highly skilled team where collaboration and shared ownership are part of everyday work.

  • Shape the future: Be part of a mission-driven company building Bitcoin financial services and setting new technical standards.

💶 Salary

Salary range: €75,000 – €120,000 gross per year.

Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, previous experience, and location.

📝 How to apply

Please reach out and include a bit about yourself, your resume or CV, examples of past projects, and a few bullet points on why you want to join 21bitcoin and what you expect.

CVs are important, but don't forget to include your favorite Bitcoin meme in your application.

🤝 Interview process

  1. Exploratory call: In a 30-minute call, we discuss what excites you about this role and ask a few questions based on your past experience.

  2. Engineering deep dive: We discuss the specific skills for the role in a 1.5-hour whiteboard session.

  3. Culture and engineering mindset: We get to know each other and talk about how you work, take ownership, and make engineering decisions.

  4. Decision time.

📍 This is a hybrid role. You are based in or near Vienna, Salzburg, or Munich and join us at our hubs a few times per month.

Applications are limited to candidates currently residing in the European Economic Area (EEA).

description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms.

 

About the Team

We are looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team, which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers, with a particular focus on French-speaking stakeholders and organisations. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio .

 

What You Will Do

  • Own account commercial outcomes: Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
  • Protect retention and renewal outcomes: Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.
  • Drive account expansion: Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas.
  • Develop account strategies: Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration.
  • Lead consultative customer conversations: Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment.
  • Navigate complex enterprise sales processes: Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes.
  • Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting: Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts.
  • Use AI to elevate your work: Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact.

 

What You Must Have

  • Full account lifecycle ownership: +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a quota-based B2B SaaS environment.
  • Proven commercial outcomes: A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion.
  • Professional fluency in French, including the ability to lead customer conversations, presentations, and commercial negotiations in French.
  • Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders, and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value.
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation.
  • Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities.
  • Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions.
  • Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Experience managing or selling to enterprise customers in the French market, regardless of where you are based.
  • Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers.
  • Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software.
  • Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees.
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks.

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.

🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

🏢 Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

🖥️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.

🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

🤝 Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

 

*Final compensation will depend on location, skills, and experience.

The applicable collective agreement is the XIX Convenio colectivo estatal de empresas de consultoría, tecnologías de la información y estudios de mercado y de la opinión pública, under professional classification Area 4 – Group/Level C2.

title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Who We Are:

At Bandwidth, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on, the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful. And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? #JoinTheBand

What We Are Looking For:

Bandwidth is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to drive net new logo acquisition across complex, high-value enterprise accounts. This is a hunter role at its core - built for someone who thrives on originating and closing six- and seven-figure ARR deals in competitive, technically sophisticated markets.

You'll operate at the intersection of CPaaS, CCaaS, and the rapidly evolving CX ecosystem, working closely with channel partners, marketing, and sales development to build and convert pipeline. You'll engage C-level and senior technical buyers, guiding them through cloud migration decisions and helping them understand why Bandwidth's carrier-grade platform is the right foundation for their communications strategy.

This role is ideal for someone with 10 years of enterprise sales experience and a deep understanding of the CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX market - including key platform players, partner ecosystems, and the buying dynamics within large enterprise organisations.

What You'll Do:

New Logo Acquisition & Pipeline Generation

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through commercial and contractual close, with a focus exclusively on new logo revenue
  • Consistently self-source pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, partner-led account mapping, inbound qualification, and collaboration with the Sales Development team
  • Build and maintain a robust, accurate pipeline with high data integrity; proactively manage forecasting and opportunity hygiene
  • Execute territory plans that target high-potential enterprise accounts, identifying the right entry points and accelerating deal velocity

Channel Partner Collaboration

  • Develop and leverage relationships with channel partners to co-source, co-sell, and accelerate new logo opportunities
  • Map accounts collaboratively with partner organisations to identify mutual pipeline and avoid duplication

Executive Engagement & Deal Leadership

  • Navigate complex enterprise organisations, building relationships across C-suite, IT, operations, procurement, digital transformation, and CX leadership
  • Act as a strategic advisor, helping enterprise buyers understand cloud migration options, communication infrastructure decisions, and the long-term value of Bandwidth's platform
  • Lead complex contract negotiations across legal, security, finance, and procurement stakeholders
  • Serve as the internal deal orchestrator - aligning resources across Product, Legal, Solutions Engineering, and Operations to structure and close

Marketing & Lead Generation Alignment

  • Work closely with marketing and demand generation teams to ensure outbound campaigns align with territory priorities
  • Provide field-level feedback on messaging, positioning, and market signals to inform campaign effectiveness
  • Leverage marketing-qualified leads alongside self-sourced pipeline to maintain a healthy and diversified funnel

Market & Product Intelligence

  • Maintain a strong and current understanding of Bandwidth's full product portfolio - voice, 911, messaging, and AI-enabled communications - and how they address enterprise operational and regulatory needs
  • Stay close to competitor positioning, pricing, and GTM dynamics across CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX markets
  • Provide informed feedback to internal teams on market positioning, competitive threats, and emerging enterprise buying patterns

What You Need:

Experience

  • Enterprise software, CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or telecom new logo sales experience
  • Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota on complex six- and seven-figure ARR deals
  • Demonstrated experience owning the full sales cycle - from self-sourced prospecting through commercial and contractual close
  • Proven ability to build and convert pipeline in competitive, technically complex sales environments
  • Consistent and demonstrable overachievement of sales goals and revenue targets

Market Knowledge

  • Deep understanding of the CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX market landscape - including key platform players, buying patterns, and enterprise decision drivers
  • Familiarity with leading enterprise CRM platforms and an understanding of how communications solutions integrate with or complement CRM ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge of cloud migration dynamics, API-first platform architectures, and how enterprises evaluate and adopt communications infrastructure
  • Working knowledge of telecom fundamentals, including SIP, PSTN, voice infrastructure, and regulatory considerations such as E911

Sales Skills

  • Exceptional outbound prospecting ability with a track record of self-sourced pipeline generation
  • Ability to build relationships at director level and above across IT, operations, procurement, digital transformation, and CX functions
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills - working effectively with solutions engineering, legal, product, marketing, and partner teams
  • Commercial acumen and ability to construct and negotiate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise agreements

Channel & Partner Experience

  • Experience collaborating with channel partners to close new logo opportunities
  • Understanding of how to engage partner organisations as a force multiplier in enterprise sales motions
  • Act as a trusted and credible partner-facing representative of Bandwidth in joint selling scenarios

Communication & Leadership

  • Ability to communicate complex technical and commercial value propositions clearly and compellingly at executive level
  • Strong pipeline and forecast discipline - comfortable operating in a data-driven, CRM-centric sales environment
  • BS/BA degree or equivalent enterprise sales experience
  • SI Proficiency: You don't just use SI — you build with it. You've created automations, workflows, or tools that others on your team rely on, combining SI with existing systems and data to solve real business problems. You design responsible use from day one.

Bonus Points:

  • Prior exposure to Bandwidth's product portfolio or existing relationships with Bandwidth's channel partners
  • Experience selling into BPO, contact centre, or AI-enabled CX environments
  • Track record of selling into complex regulated industries where compliance, resiliency, and security are key buying criteria
  • Experience working alongside or within a structured Channel, Alliance, or Partner sales organisation

The Whole Person Promise: 

At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

  • Work laptop & mobile phone with a competitive subscription plan, and an internet allowance to support the costs of the Internet at home.
  • We contribute 8% of your monthly gross salary into your private pension.
  • Income protection plan to ensure you'll receive a regular income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury.
  • Life insurance providing financial support to your loved ones in the event of your unexpected passing.
  • Health insurance, with extensive coverage, a simple claim process and the possibility to cover your life partner and children.
  • Extensive Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24/7 counseling and support on all areas of life (personal and professional).
  • Unlimited, free and anonymous consultations with our dedicated therapist.
  • Childcare support
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • 24 days annual leave per year and 1 additional day every 3 years.
  • Time-Off Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you're embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your time-off - not even with email.
  • Additional time-off can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.
  • "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.
  • 90-Minute Workout Lunches, contribution to your monthly fitness subscription and unlimited virtual meetings with our very own nutritionist.

 

Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you're 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us!

Position overview

Orakl runs its data and AI platform on AWS: Dagster pipelines, a versioned PostgreSQL warehouse, ephemeral Fargate and EC2 compute, eight microservices.

Unique in-house and hospital-provided biological, clinical and omics data flow through it every day. We continuously train our proprietary AI models on this every day to create new scientific insights that will benefit patients.

We are hiring a Platform Engineer across three missions: infrastructure, security and scalability. You will be our first dedicated platform hire, and you will decide what this platform looks like for the next years. This is a high-stakes, high-ownership position.

Our stack

  • Cloud: AWS (Paris region), cross-cloud backup to a second European provider

  • Compute: ECS and Fargate, EC2, ephemeral provisioning per job

  • Data: PostgreSQL, S3, versioned transformations

  • Code: Python everywhere, Docker, Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Dagster orchestration, Nextflow

What you will be doing

1. Security: Codebase, incident management, AI guardrails, fleet management.

These are the main things that you will be focusing during your first months with us:

  • Secure the codebase: workflow permissions, pinned actions, dependency and secret scanning, package security.

  • Run vulnerability watch and build our incident response tooling: establish the blast radius, write the fix, deploy it company-wide, run the postmortem.

  • Define our AI guardrails: we use AI tools heavily and we are embedding them in the product, so we need clear rules on which data those tools may reach and how their output is reviewed before it ships.

  • Develop our fleet management tools to **keep our laptops up-to-date and secure, define and enforce security practices, deploy and maintain management and security tooling to our fleet.

2. Infrastructure management: Compute, data access, observability.

  • Own our AWS compute: VPC and network segmentation, EC2 allocation.

  • Support data storage. As the team and our partner base grow, access to sensitive data has to stay compartmented and auditable. You will be consulted on where data belongs, across RDS, Redshift, PostgreSQL and the rest, and on keeping access to it properly controlled.

  • Build the observability layer: metrics, logs and traces in one place, alerting that fires on real failures.

  • Own secure access to our infrastructure: secure networks, access control and policies, observability.

3. Scalability: Improve the tools we have, choose the ones we will need.

  • Our product is being built and the volume of data coming in keeps growing, which will call for architecture and resources we do not use today. You will be expected to anticipate failures and future needs, and bring your expert knowledge and experience to our systems & designs.

Who you are

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in platform, infrastructure or site reliability engineering, with security a real part of the job rather than an occasional task.

  • Deep hands-on AWS: IAM and identity management, VPC design, RDS, container orchestration, secrets management, federated authentication for CI.

  • Terraform in production with a real review workflow behind it, and containers you have operated rather than only deployed to.

  • Ownership of CI/CD security, ideally GitHub Actions: supply chain integrity, dependency management, build provenance.

  • Incident response as a practitioner. You have been the person on the hook, not the person who read the report afterwards.

  • Fluent in English.

Preferred qualifications

  • Highly sensitive data in a high-stakes regulated sector: health, finance or defence.

  • Working knowledge of French health data regulation (HDS, CNIL, GDPR), or another regulated environment and the appetite to learn this one quickly.

  • Device management at scale (Jamf, Kandji, Fleet or equivalent) and automated joiner, mover and leaver processes.

  • Dagster or a comparable orchestration framework, and PostgreSQL in production.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience relative to the role.

  3. Technical Case: A exercise representative of the real challenges you'll face.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with several people with whom you've worked closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

Position overview

Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams.

  • Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities.

  • In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project.

  • Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds.

  • Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests.

  • Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists.

  • Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step.

  • Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly.

  • Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs.

  • Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management.

  • Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes.

  • Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects.

  • Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting.

  • You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes.
